mapping.title: Account mapping
mapping.lead: One place for {company}: what Nexus posts, and the accountant's account it lands in, each from a day.

noAccess.title: You cannot see the account mapping
noAccess.body: Reading it needs the accounting permission (accounting.view). Ask your administrator.

gate.title: To confirm with the accountant
gate.body: The keys and the accounts are Nexus's reading of the accountant's chart until the accountant confirms them: download the mapping and hand it over. A row applies from its first day and is fixed from then on; a change is a new row from a later day.

facts.keys_one: Nexus posts {count} key in this company.
facts.keys_other: Nexus posts {count} keys in this company.
facts.unmapped_one: {count} key has no account today: its lines in the entries go blank.
facts.unmapped_other: {count} keys have no account today: their lines in the entries go blank.
facts.allMapped: Every key Nexus posts has an account today.
facts.rule: A document takes the account in force on its own day, so what was handed over keeps its account.
facts.where: The journals' entries files use the mapping only while the journals are switched on.

mapping.keysLead: Each key with its account today, the next change and the earlier accounts. Open a key to map it.
mapping.otherLead: Rows kept for keys Nexus does not post (a code no longer used): they map nothing.

noMatch.title: No key matches
noMatch.body: No key of this kind and view matches the search.
noMatch.other: Every row names a key Nexus posts: nothing is kept apart.

empty.title: No key to map
empty.body: Nexus posts no key in this company yet.

mapping.otherBody: This row is kept from before and maps nothing. It stays in the history; a row from a later day can still be removed.

dialog.accountHint: The accountant's account code: letters, digits and . _ / - (for example 60.01.02).
dialog.fixed: Fixed from its first day: a change is a new row from a later day.
dialog.noAccountBody: No account is in force today: the entries' lines of this key reach the accountant blank.
dialog.addFirstHint: A key's first account may start earlier: it fills the days that had no account (for example 1 January).
dialog.addChange: Map to another account from a day
dialog.addChangeHint: A change starts today or later, so what was handed over keeps its account.

done.changed: The row from {day} now maps to {account}.

bulk.lead: Each key gets its own row with this account, from this day. A key refused says why; the others are made.
bulk.fromHint: A key mapped already changes from today or later.

held.noManage: Changing the mapping needs the mapping permission (accounting.mapping.manage).
held.notPosted: Nexus posts no such key: there is nothing to map.
held.running: It closes once every key is sent.
held.reading: The mapping is still being read.
held.accountShape: An account is 1 to 40 letters, digits and . _ / -, starting with a letter or a digit.
held.day: Choose the day it applies from.
held.backdated: This key is mapped already: a change starts today or later.
held.sameDay: This key has a row from that day already: change that row, or pick another day.
held.note: A note is at most {max} characters.
held.fixed: This row applies since {day}: it is fixed. A change is a new row from a later day.
held.nothingChanges: Nothing changes: the row is already so.
held.bulkNotPosted_one: {count} key chosen is not posted by Nexus: leave it out.
held.bulkNotPosted_other: {count} keys chosen are not posted by Nexus: leave them out.
held.bulkBackdated_one: {count} key chosen is mapped already: it changes from today or later.
held.bulkBackdated_other: {count} keys chosen are mapped already: they change from today or later.
held.bulkSameDay_one: {count} key chosen has a row from that day already: pick another day.
held.bulkSameDay_other: {count} keys chosen have a row from that day already: pick another day.

refusal.FIXED: This row applies already: it is fixed. A change is a new row from a later day.
refusal.BACKDATED: This key is mapped already: a change starts today or later.
refusal.SAME_DAY: This key has a row from that day already.
refusal.NOTHING_CHANGES: Nothing changes: the row is already so.
refusal.UNKNOWN_KEY: Nexus no longer posts this key: the mapping is read again.

journals.title: Journals with mapped accounts
journals.stepUp: Switching the journals asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.

on.words: The journals carry their entries with the mapped accounts (sales, purchases, payments, cost of goods sold and variances): the accountant's software imports them.
on.what: From the next export, each journal goes with an entries file: every document as one entry, the accounts mapped on its own day.
on.checks: Two checks join the export: "Every account mapped" and "Journal entries balance".
on.unmapped_one: {count} key has no account today: its lines go blank until it is mapped.
on.unmapped_other: {count} keys have no account today: their lines go blank until they are mapped.
on.gate: Switch them on once the accountant has confirmed the mapping.

off.words: Waits for the accountant: the journals go without mapped entries until a person switches them on, once the accountant has confirmed the mapping.
off.what: From the next export, the journals go without their entries files.
off.handedOver: Batches made before keep their files as they are.

from.TENANT: Set for every company of the organisation.

dialog.code: Then your authenticator code is asked.

done.on: The journals carry their entries from the next export.
done.off: The journals go without their entries from the next export.

held.noSwitch: Switching the journals needs its permission (accounting.journals.switch).
held.running: It closes once the switch is answered.
held.reason: A reason is at most {max} characters.

contents.on: The journals go with their entries, the accounts mapped on each document's day.
contents.off: The journals go without mapped entries: they wait for the accountant to confirm the mapping.

hard.title: Close {month} for good?
hard.lead: Nothing dated {month} can change once it is closed.

what.nothing: Invoices, credit notes, payments, supplier invoices, stock moves and work-order costs dated {month} are refused for everyone: the database itself refuses them.
what.correct: A correction then goes in an open month: a credit note or an adjustment dated after {month}.
what.lift: Only a person with accounting.unlock (the owner) lifts it, with a reason and a fresh code.
what.accountant: Nothing is sent to the accountant: you hand the files over.

hard.problems: {month} cannot be closed for good yet:
hard.code: Then your authenticator code is asked.

held.noClose: Closing a month for good needs its permission (accounting.close).
held.running: It closes once the close is answered.

integrity.title: Nightly checks
integrity.lead: Every night Nexus checks the documents from {from} to {to} and keeps each check's result; the export reads the last run.
integrity.leadShort: Every night Nexus checks the documents of this month and the twelve before; the export reads the last run.
integrity.error: It could not run: it is tried again tonight.
integrity.export: A failing nightly check does not hold the export: it says what the accountant would find.

held.noRun: Running the checks needs the export permission (accounting.export).

INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.title: Invoices' totals equal their lines
INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.pass: Every invoice's totals equal its VAT summary and its lines.
INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.fail_one: {count} invoice has totals that are not the sums of its lines.
INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.fail_other: {count} invoices have totals that are not the sums of their lines.

SUPPLIER_INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.title: Supplier invoices' totals equal their lines
SUPPLIER_INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.pass: Every supplier invoice's totals equal its VAT summary and its lines.
SUPPLIER_INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.fail_one: {count} supplier invoice has totals that are not the sums of its lines.
SUPPLIER_INVOICE_TOTALS_EQUAL_LINES.fail_other: {count} supplier invoices have totals that are not the sums of their lines.

ALLOCATIONS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.title: Placements never exceed payments
ALLOCATIONS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.pass: No payment is placed beyond its amount and no invoice is paid beyond its total.
ALLOCATIONS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.fail_one: {count} payment or invoice is placed beyond its amount.
ALLOCATIONS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.fail_other: {count} payments or invoices are placed beyond their amounts.

PAYMENTS_PLACED.title: Payments placed
PAYMENTS_PLACED.pass: Every payment received is placed, refunded or written off.

LEDGER_BALANCES.title: Journal entries balance
LEDGER_BALANCES.pass: Every journal entry's debits equal its credits.

EXPORTED_DOCUMENTS_UNCHANGED.title: Exported documents unchanged
EXPORTED_DOCUMENTS_UNCHANGED.pass: No document handed over in an export changed since.
EXPORTED_DOCUMENTS_UNCHANGED.fail_one: {count} document changed after it was handed over: a re-export carries it.
EXPORTED_DOCUMENTS_UNCHANGED.fail_other: {count} documents changed after they were handed over: a re-export carries them.

failure.SUMMARY: totals differ from the VAT summary
